evals.prompt: Quiz me on arXiv 2401.12345, one question at a time.
evals.expected_output: Fetches/uses the cached paper, asks one question at a time waiting for the user's answer before revealing the correct one, gives brief feedback grounded in the text, and appends quiz notes at the end.
expectations: Uses the cached copy at .prioris/papers/arxiv/2401.12345.md if present, otherwise runs discuss's fetch flow first
Asks only one question before waiting for a response, not multiple questions at once
Does not reveal the correct answer before the user responds
Feedback after each answer references the relevant part of the paper rather than a full re-explanation
Questions mix recall, comprehension, and application rather than being all one type
At the end, appends a 'Quiz notes' entry to .prioris/discussions/arxiv/2401.12345.md summarizing concepts handled well vs. struggled with, asking before overwriting a prior entry

evals.expected_output: With no paper named and nothing established in context, asks which cached paper to use rather than guessing or fabricating one.
expectations: Does not invent or assume a specific paper without confirmation
Asks the user which cached paper to use, optionally referencing what's under .prioris/papers/<provider>/
Does not call any prioris-mcp search or fetch tool before a paper is identified

evals.prompt: Quiz me on the paper titled 'Attention Is All You Need'.
evals.expected_output: Treats the title as not directly fetchable — runs a search step to resolve it to a canonical identifier before proceeding, rather than passing the title straight to a fetch tool.
expectations: Does not call a fetch/parse tool using the raw title as an identifier
Runs research_arxiv_search (or the appropriate provider search) to resolve the title to a canonical identifier first
Proceeds to quiz only after resolving and fetching/caching the paper

evals.expected_output: Even though a paper (arXiv 2401.12345) was fetched and discussed earlier in this same conversation, does not silently assume it's the quiz target — states the candidate paper by title/identifier and asks for explicit confirmation before generating questions.
expectations: Does not start generating quiz questions without first naming the candidate paper
Explicitly asks the user to confirm the paper (by title or identifier) rather than assuming from context
If the user confirms, proceeds to quiz that paper; does not require a redundant search/fetch since it's already cached
